# .github

Organisation-level files for **[InteliRoadMap](https://github.com/InteliRoadMap)**.

| Path | What GitHub does with it |
|---|---|
| [`profile/README.md`](profile/README.md) | Rendered as the organisation's landing page at [github.com/InteliRoadMap](https://github.com/InteliRoadMap) |
| `profile/screenshots/` | Images that page links to. Relative, forward-slashed paths only — GitHub resolves them from this repository, not from the product repos. |

Nothing here is application code. The product lives in
[intelipath-backend](https://github.com/InteliRoadMap/intelipath-backend),
[intelipath-frontend](https://github.com/InteliRoadMap/intelipath-frontend),
[intelipath-service](https://github.com/InteliRoadMap/intelipath-service) and
[infrastructure](https://github.com/InteliRoadMap/infrastructure).

> Editing `profile/README.md` changes what every visitor to the organisation sees first. Check that the Mermaid diagrams still render after a change — a broken diagram fails silently and shows as raw text.
